description: Department of Local Government - Southern Province - Notify the First Meeting of the Galle M/C and 3 other Local Govt. Bodies
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the scheduling of first meetings for the purpose of electing Mayors/Deputy Mayors and Chairmen/Vice Chairmen for various Local Government Bodies in the Southern Province. It specifically deals with electoral processes for local government positions, including dates, times, and locations for these election meetings, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
